palette: Deep blue-silver, near-black cosmic facets, and sparse white-gold star points.
valueRange: Strong dark-to-bright contrast controlled along facets and edges.
surfaceAndWear: Flawless faceted alloy, meteor-like grain, razor-clean edges, almost no mundane corrosion.
constructionVocabulary: Extraordinary tapered geometry, orbit-like negative spaces, fine celestial inlay, precise floating impression while connected.
supernaturalBehavior: Sparse star-point glints and a faint depth within dark facets; never a full aura.
neutralSecondaryMaterials: Black leather, dark hardwood, silver, and charcoal textile.
neighborDifference: More cosmic, faceted, and extraordinary than Skyiron; colder and less solar than Sunsteel.
